items.title: Iran / Strait of Hormuz escalation
items.detail: Trump reinstated an Iranian shipping blockade Jul 13; Brent +3.7% to ~$78.85. ~20% of global oil/gas transits Hormuz — sustained disruption is the market's top tail risk and an inflation re-acceleration path.

items.title: Memory-chip oversupply
items.detail: SK Hynix -15% on a profit warning dragged MU/STX/SNDK. A memory-cycle rollover would hit the semis complex even as AI-logic holds.

items.title: AI-capex concentration
items.detail: Index leadership and earnings growth are concentrated in a handful of AI-capex names; any hyperscaler capex pause would hit NVDA/AVGO/VRT/power names together.

items.title: Elevated valuations
items.detail: S&P ~8.3% above its 200DMA with VIX ~17. Little cushion for a growth or geopolitical shock.

items.title: Fed on hold with a tightening bias
items.detail: Target 3.50-3.75%, held a 4th straight meeting; July 28-29 expected hold but officials keep the option to hike if inflation persists. Today's cool CPI (3.5%) eases this near-term.

items.title: Q2 bank-earnings kickoff
items.detail: JPM, GS, BAC report this week; credit-cost normalization or weak guidance could sour financials sentiment.

items.title: Low-VIX complacency
items.detail: VIX ~17 into a geopolitical flare-up suggests limited hedging; volatility could gap on Hormuz headlines.
